## GroupUtils.isGroupInput() function

Returns whether an entry is an explicit group rather than a standalone offer.

Plain offer objects can also contain incidental `offers` properties, so the discriminant must reject values that still carry the offer `market` field.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function isGroupInput(entry: GroupInput): entry is IGroup;
```
